Micro WarsCell Rampage

A drop of agar under the lens. Grow, link and outlast the other organisms.

Stages

Win a stage to open the next one. ✓ won · ▶ open · 🔒︎ locked

Paused

Drag from one of your cells toward any cell to grow a tentacle (letting go near a cell is enough: the line shows which one), or tap your cell and then the target. A tentacle costs one unit per stretch of length as it grows, and its pulses are free. A grey cell shows its value: send it a third of that to win it whole. Swipe across your tentacle, or tap it, to cut it there: the part toward the target goes on, the rest comes home, units already travelling are lost. Enemy tentacles cannot be cut. Grey bars are walls: no tentacle crosses them. A cell's shape tells its kind: round is ordinary; spiked attacks (its units count double against others); an armoured hexagon defends (a cut into it sends nothing on); three budding lobes heal (its units count double into your own cells); a ring of hairs holds one more tentacle. A full cell keeps up to a third more units in an outer ring and sends faster while it does. Stage 1 is won by owning every grey cell; every other stage by eliminating every enemy. The speed button cycles ×1, ×2, ×4 and pause; you can still grow and cut while paused. Keys: Esc back · Space pause · F speed · R restart · after a match N next stage, R retry
